text:
anya: Noticing a new "soft-EOS oscillation" on the canary for glacier-lite-int4. Streaming tool calls sometimes end with duplicated punctuation or drop mid-object. Samples look different from classic trailing-comma cases.

sam: Soft-EOS oscillation? Can you paste an example?

anya: Sanitized snippet: \n{"op":"create","body":{"title":"X","desc":"..."}}}
...stream ends...

lee: Two close-brace tokens then cutoff. That smells like a tie-flip where '}' and EOS both have similar scores after PTQ.

juniper: Is this only on streaming? Any difference in synchronous completion?

anya: Sync completes fine. Problem isolated to streaming path. Runtime chunk traces show the PTQ variant often emits one fewer chunk on long tails.

ci-bot: Running structured-output-sanity(500) + token-align(punctuation focus, 800 samples) for glacier-lite-int4 vs baseline. ETA ~90s.

sam: Short-term we can: (A) opt-in resume-probe for canary (send max_tokens=4 continuation when trailing pattern matches mid-JSON signatures), and (B) a lightweight "json-stitcher" postprocess that removes duplicate trailing punct and tries minimal closure. Both should flag healed outputs and preserve raw logs.

lee: Add healed_by (resume, stitch_close, strip_comma) metrics and a golden prompt smoke of 400 critical toolcall prompts. Also run kv-cache-off canary to rule out cache amplification.

ci-bot: Results: glacier-lite-int4 parse_success=91.6%, resumed_success=2.8%, stitched_success=3.7%, final_failure=1.9%. baseline parse_success=95.8%, stitched_success=0.4%, final_failure=3.8%. Full artifacts uploaded to /canary/reports/glacier-lite-int4/3649999999.json

sam: Healing recovers some but raw parse gap ~4.2%. Action items: (1) quick PTQ recalibration sweep (per-channel / per-tensor / tiny-clipping) over the canary dataset, (2) token-align diff inspection for punctuation/EOS, (3) run kv-cache-off canary, (4) enable resume+stitch only for canary and surface healed metrics.

juniper: Release gate: hold rollout until raw parse_success >= 95% or combined healed (parse+resumed+stitched) >= baseline_parse_success - 0.5% with healed flagging in logs. If sweep doesn't close gap, we'll escalate to infra and quant leads.

anya: I'll coordinate the sweep and dashboard tiles (healed_by_type, healed_rate, raw_parse_success). Will post updates here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
